item.title: This is the Nothing Phone (4a)
item.description: Nothing has issued an official reveal of the Nothing Phone (4a) design, and it demonstrates a major course change for the brand’s defining innovation. The Nothing Phone (4a) won’t be officially unveiled until 5 March, but the London-based brand has just posted a clear image of the rear of the phone. In an X post confirming the launch date and time (10:30 GMT), Nothing promises a mid-range smartphone that will be “Built different”. item.title: The Dyson floor cleaner I’ve been waiting for is out now
item.description: Dyson’s brand-new, slim and manoeuvrable wet floor cleaner is out now in the UK. It’s called the PencilWash and it’s priced at £299.99. You can get yours from Dyson. It’ll be available from 14 March in the US for $349. It’s the mopping equivalent of Dyson’s slender PencilVac, which you can buy from Dyson UK for a pricier £429.99 and Dyson US for $449.99.
